notes.title: Content update #1: Mekanika now released!
notes.notes:
[b]Ready to roll again?[/b]
The world of Spin & Roll gets turned on its head as the world of [b]machines [/b]and [b]mechanization [/b]come head to head in [b][i]15 brand new stages[/i][/b] loaded full of new [b]hazards[/b], tricky [b]traps [/b]and even more [b]deadly foes[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39540834/f21f07d703ca10992f7c20be2d0a7cbef271ba6f.png[/img]

Weave your way around [i]electrical conduits[/i], avoid [i]spikey new hazards[/i], dodge whirling [i]Mekopters [/i]and try not to fall prey to the hovering [i]Bombits[/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39540834/08075c607e8aa65e7a6827378f6dd452e3426974.png[/img]

Each new stage has been carefully crafted to pack the game with a [b]fresh new look and feel[/b] whilst still giving you a familiar sense of challenge and fun. And with even [b]bigger levels than ever before[/b], there's much, much more to see and do in this [i]jam-packed[/i] content update!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39540834/aa30244b7d467b8897a4b6ca50c7a5b413c26696.png[/img]

We hope you enjoy this new pack as much as we had creating it!
- Savania Games

notes.title: Version 1.2.0 released
notes.notes:
We recently updated Spin & Roll with a new patch. Please find the latest patch details below.

[b]Patch 1.2.0[/b]

• Fixed an issue where fountain sound effect wasn't set to the current SFX volume level.

• Resolved a problem where bombs weren't stopping whilst the game was paused.

• Reduced ambient sound of some looping objects.

• Fixed an issue where you could fall into a hole in the level 'Duck and cover' but could not escape it (you will now correctly lose a ball for doing so!).

• When using the keyboard, pressing ESC now pauses the game.

notes.title: Now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Spin & Roll[/b], our first major release, is [i][b]now available to purchase on the Steam store[/b][/i].

[b]Spin & Roll[/b] offers [i]25 crazy, wild worlds[/i] full of [i]hazards and traps[/i], with even more launching as [i][b]completely free[/b][/i] DLC in the coming weeks.

We want to thank [i]everybody[/i] for their support in the last few weeks, we've been overwhelmed by the positivity and feedback we've received during our pre-release period. Now that the game is launched, we hope you'll enjoy playing it as much as we've done building it for you.

[b]Thank you, eveyone![/b] ːsteamthumbsupː

notes.title: One week to go!
notes.notes:
[b]Spin & Roll launching next week![/b]

[b]We're just one week away from launch![/b], and we wanted to thank everybody for their messages and emails. We're thrilled to bring you our first game and we have a lot of content planned in the coming weeks to add even more fun challenges for you to enjoy!

Spin & Roll is a colourful, fun and challenging arcade platforming game that sees you rolling across twisting, topsy-turvy courses full of traps, tricks and hazards in the pursuit of collecting as many coins and secrets as you can! Shoot for the best trophies you can and try and unlock master mode for an even bigger challenge!

[b]In the weeks following Spin & Roll's launch we'll be putting out our first major content update: [i]Mekanika[/i]which adds even more courses, challenges and dangers![/b]

notes.title: Official Launch - February 1st 2021!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce that Spin & Roll will be launching on Steam on [b]February 1st 2021[/b]! And we're not stopping there - we have our first major [b]Content Update[/b] in the pipeline for the following month of [b]March[/b] where you'll be able to enjoy even more [i]action-puzzling[/i] fun! We'll post more details about this soon, so keep an eye our for further news.

We're committed to making sure you get the best bang for your buck, which is why we're planning a whole slew of completely and absolutely free content updates after the game launch. It's part of our continued commitment to our [b]Content Promise[/b] to give back to the community that helps us support the game.

For more on this and everything else, don't forget to [url=https://www.savaniagames.co.uk]visit our website[/url] for further updates!
